## Change type

<!-- Check all that apply -->

- [ ] `feat` — new tool, resource, prompt, or capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix in existing behavior
- [ ] `docs` — README/SPEC/other documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `chore`/`ci` — build, scripts, CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes (`npm test` passes)
- [ ] SPEC.md updated if any tool contract changed (inputs, outputs, endpoints, pagination)
- [ ] Docs (README) updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Only non-deprecated Spotify Web API endpoints used
- [ ] Conventional Commit title
- [ ] No tokens, Client IDs, or `.env` contents committed
